# Each

Calls a lambda once for each element of an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Each(items, callback)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to read. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |
| `callback` | function | A lambda of exactly one parameter, which receives the element; its result is ignored. A lambda of any other number of parameters, or a value that is not a lambda, null included, is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Null, always.

## Remarks

The lambda is called in order, for what it does rather than for its result. It is given the elements the array holds when the call starts, so a change the lambda makes to the array does not change which elements it is given.

## Example

`Each(items, item => item.count++)` adds one to the `count` of each element of `items`.
